title: Emergency scheme generation method, system and storage medium under federated learning framework
assignee: Information and Telecommunication Branch of State Grid Liaoning Electric Power Co Ltd

pse.problem: Existing methods for emergency plan generation suffer from low accuracy due to ignoring the privacy and security of local historical case databases, limited historical case base of single industrial enterprises, and difficulty in solving emergency decision-making problems with characteristics of high uncertainty and complexity.
pse.solution_function: The invention generates an emergency plan under a federated learning framework by collectively training a K-means clustering model using local historical emergency case data from multiple industrial enterprises. The model calculates the similarity between the target case and the historical emergency cases based on the eigenvalue vector, extracts the most relevant local historical case emergency plan, and sends it to a central server.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of n enterprise clients (FF1, F2, ..., Fn) and a central server. Each enterprise client has its own historical emergency case set (Zzi), data scale (Si), and local historical cases (iai).
pse.solution_implementation: The enterprise clients preprocess their local historical emergency case data to form a training data set. They jointly train the K-means clustering model based on their respective training data sets. Upon receiving the eigenvalue vector of the target case from the central server, each client calculates the similarity between the target case and its historical emergency cases based on the eigenvalue vector and extracts the local historical case emergency plan according to the similarity ranking.
pse.effect: The solution enhances the accuracy of emergency plan generation by effectively mining and utilizing local historical case databases from multiple industrial enterprises. This results in more efficient and effective emergency measures and plans.
